summary: Atlantic Union Bankshares Corp filed an 8-K on July 27, 2026, to report entry into an underwriting agreement for a $250 million offering of 6.25% Fixed-to-Floating Rate Subordinated Notes due 2036 at par. The net proceeds will repay $168 million of outstanding 4.25% subordinated notes due 2029 and for general corporate purposes. The offering is expected to close July 30, 2026, contingent on customary conditions. This is a routine debt capital raise with a conditional redemption of existing notes, not a transformative special situation. No board recommendation, advisor, or premium is involved, as it is a straight debt issuance under an existing shelf registration. What to watch: the concurrent conditional redemption and use of proceeds for growth.
